rule_name: Multiple cash deposits just below £10,000 within 10 days
trigger_summary: 6 cash deposits of £9,200-£9,900 at 5 branches over 8 days, followed by a £56,000 CHAPS payment.

rule_name: Single credit exceeds 50% of declared annual income
trigger_summary: £287,450 CHAPS credit from a solicitors' firm against declared income of £41,000.

rule_name: Payment screening hit on beneficiary name
trigger_summary: Outbound SWIFT payment of £148,000 to 'Zarovel Shipping and Trading FZE' (QK) hit the sanctions screening filter.
Customer name 'Rebecca Hartmann' returned a similarity hit against a sanctions list entry during periodic re-screening.
7 incoming payments from unrelated individuals in 6 days, each moved on within hours to a crypto exchange or withdrawn as cash.

rule_name: Payments to higher-risk jurisdiction exceed £20,000 in a month
trigger_summary: £24,800 SWIFT payment to a supplier in QM (higher-risk jurisdiction).
30-day credits of about £59,000 against expected monthly turnover of £15,000.
£95,000 SWIFT credit from a consultancy in QK referenced 'advisory services', £60,000 moved to a family trust 2 days later.

rule_name: Repeated round-amount transfers returned by the same counterparty
trigger_summary: 3 round-amount payments (£50k, £75k, £50k) to a related company, each returned within 4 days less 1-2%.

rule_name: Dormant account (>180 days) receives credit above £5,000
trigger_summary: Account inactive for over a year receives £18,500 from an unknown individual; £15,000 sent to a new payee within 2 hours, plus cash withdrawals.

rule_name: Salary credits increased by more than 75% vs 6-month average
trigger_summary: Salary credits rose from about £3,520 to £6,450 per month, plus a £4,000 one-off credit from the same employer.

rule_name: Charity payment to individual not on approved beneficiary list
trigger_summary: £12,000 Faster Payment to a private individual referenced 'consultancy', outside the approved beneficiary list.

rule_name: New account receiving credits from more than 20 distinct individuals in 30 days
trigger_summary: 34 Faster Payments from different individuals (£45-£320) in a 2-month-old business account.
